description: The Zenodo BACI-VI-Bench v0.3 archive contains processed variational-inequality instances derived from CEPII-BACI bilateral trade records for 2017–2024. The producer lists eight year-level instances with five commodity sectors, ten exporters and ten importers, plus five sector-level instances for 2022. The package includes normalized trade-flow tensors, exporter capacity sets, calibrated operator coefficients, solver diagnostics and construction scripts. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 for the archived benchmark. Original CEPII-BACI source files are not in this public release and must be obtained separately under their own terms. These economic trade-flow graphs can test supply-chain equilibrium or disruption methods, but the single route dimension is a benchmark abstraction, not mapped physical freight corridors. Country selection and calibration defaults are limitations for infrastructure operations claims. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing network-equilibrium solvers under commodity-flow shocks. data-un-comtrade is a related trade-statistics resource with distinct definitions. No benchmark archive or raw CEPII file was downloaded. The processed instances can also test international supply-chain simulations under commodity-flow shocks.
